title: DeepSeek looks for fresh capital as founder’s quant empire navigates China’s choppy IPO market
summary_full: High-Flyer Quant, which bankrolled DeepSeek, has come to the fore, making a push into new listings as it chases returns in China's red-hot IPO market.
